title: Greenroom launch checklist and signal play
content:
Purpose and scope:
This doc is the working greenroom checklist + signal play for feature launches that need coordinated product-ops, SRE, and support coverage. It is intended to be used in the 72-hour lead-up (greenroom) through the first 72 hours post ramp. Focus areas: KPI readiness, monitoring signals, escalation triggers, rollback criteria, quick experiment gating, and a short postmortem template.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Owners: Product (Ethan Patel) / Product Ops (Asha) / SRE (Diego) / Support Lead (Hannah).
- Launch window: 2025-12-08 10:00 PT — phased traffic shift over 6 hours.
- Primary KPI targets: error rate < 0.25% p95 latency < 220ms for 95% of requests after steady state. Adoption target: first 24h 5k unique users, 7% conversion to upgraded API tier.
- Rollback trigger: sustained tier-1 errors > 0.5% for 10 minutes or p95 latency > 450ms for 15 minutes.

Pre-greenroom checklist (owners in parentheses) — complete before formal greenroom kickoff (T-minus 72h):
- Feature flags verified in staging and can be toggled remotely (Engineering).
- Canary configuration validated: canary routing, mock traffic scenario deployed (Release Eng).
- SLOs and alerting created and smoke-tested in alerting dashboard (SRE).
- Cost guardrails created for burst traffic (FinOps/Platform).
- Support playbook draft uploaded to shared drive and support runbook card created in Zendesk (Support).
- Rollback playbook (explicit steps) mapped and dry-run performed once (Engineering + SRE).

Greenroom kickoff (T-minus 48–24h):
- 48h sync call: confirm owners, finalize ramp schedule, confirm monitoring dashboards and alert contacts. (Host: Product Ops)
- Run a full smoke run: 1k synthetic users across traffic profile, validate end-to-end from edge -> runtime -> metrics -> billing. (Release Eng + SRE)
- KPI baseline snapshot: capture 24h baseline for errors, latency, throughput, token cost, and user conversion. Save export to: linked_artifacts Confluence page. (Product Ops)
- Canary window plan: detail staged percentages and timing (e.g., 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% over 6h), include wait periods and decision owners. (Product)
- Communications: scheduled announcements to customer beta users and internal channels (GTM, Support, SRE). (GTM/Product Ops)

Launch day playbook (T=0 to +6h ramp):
- Phase 0 (T=0): enable feature flag for 1% traffic. Observe 20m. Primary checks: 200 synthetic/h matches, error rate, p95 latency, KV cache hit ratios, memory/GPU utilization. (Owners: Engineering on-call; SRE watcher)
- Decision gate (after observation window): green/orange/red. Green = proceed to next step; Orange = extend observation and reduce next increment; Red = trigger rollback. Decision owner: Product lead (Ethan) with SRE concurrence.
- Phase increments: 1% -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (60m) -> 60% (120m) -> full (final manual approval). Include automated rollback if critical alerts fire.
- Observability checklist per phase: errors by endpoint, model overhead token time, cache eviction rates, CPU/GPU saturation, downstream service latencies, billing meter anomalies. (SRE + Product Ops)

Key signals and thresholds (operators should treat these as canonical):
- Tier-1 errors: any 5xx or failed model generation (threshold for attention = 0.5% sustained over 10m).
- Latency: p95 > 450ms for 15m = red. p95 220–450ms for 15m = orange.
- Resource saturation: GPU memory > 88% or swap usage > 2% = orange; sustained >95% = red.
- Cost anomaly: per-token cost > 2x expected for 30m = orange and notify FinOps.
- Behavioral KPI drift: conversion to upgraded API tier deviates > 30% vs forecast in first 6h = investigate.

Escalation flow and contact list (primary, secondary):
- Engineering on-call: Diego Morales (primary), Jamal Rivera (secondary).
- SRE lead: Diego Morales (primary), Grace Osei (secondary).
- Product lead: Ethan Patel (primary), Asha Kapoor (secondary).
- Support lead: Hannah Li (primary).
- Exec notify (if red and not resolved in 30m): VP Product (Slack / page).

Automations and runbook hooks to enable before ramp:
- Auto-rollback toggle in release controller if critical alert fires (Enable by Release Eng).
- Synthetic probes running every 30s with differential checks against baseline (SRE).
- Automated snapshot export of metrics to the product-runway KPI sheet at each phase (Product Ops).

Contingency playbook (quick reference):
- If orange signals appear: pause ramp, start 30m investigation with root cause triage (trace, logs, model-run breakdown). If mitigation found (rate limit tweak, cache priming, config flag), test fix in canary and resume.
- If red signals appear: immediate rollback to last known-good (documented step-by-step). Post-rollback: open hotfix ticket, notify stakeholders, run postmortem within 48h.
- If partial customer impact (subset of users): apply targeted traffic steering and alert affected CSMs.

Post-launch (T+6h to T+72h):
- 6h checkpoint: capture KPI deltas, escalate any lingering orange signals. (Product Ops)
- 24h checkpoint: run full adoption and cost report, decide on wider rollout. (Product + FinOps)
- 72h postmortem draft: initial timeline, actions taken, residual risk items, and next steps. (Product Ops owner)

Quick postmortem template (fill within 24–72h):
- Summary (1–2 lines): what launched, who owns it, and outcome.
- Timeline: bulleted minute-level events for the 6h ramp and key interventions.
- Signals observed: list top 5 metrics that diverged and timestamps.
- Root cause (hypothesis + evidence): short narrative.
- Mitigations applied and why they worked/didn’t.
- Customer impact and comms: list affected tenants and messages sent.
- Action items (owner + due date): clear A/R/A — bug fix, monitoring change, SLO update, runbook addition.

KPI tracker (minimal fields to copy into sheet):
- phase, start_time, end_time, traffic_pct, requests_per_min, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, errors_percent, gpu_util_percent, token_cost_per_request_usd, adoption_delta_percent

Notes, open questions and follow-ups:
- Confirm whether dedicated infra for this feature should be pinned (cost vs isolation). (Action: Product + Infra)
- Verify global rollout window for APAC — may need separate ramp timing due to region capacity. (Action: Release Eng)
- Add a synthetic that validates model output correctness for the top 10 prompt templates (Product).

References and docs:
- Confluence: Launch Greenroom Playbook (linked_artifacts).
- Release ticket: JIRA-4567 (linked_artifacts).
- Support runbook stub: Zendesk card (internal link).

Ownership sign-off checklist (required before final rollout):
- Product lead: confirm KPI targets and decision gates.
- SRE lead: confirm alerting, automated rollback, and observability.
- Release Eng: confirm feature flag and canary controls.
- Support lead: confirm runbook and staffing.
- Finance: confirm cost guardrails or approval for temporary burst.

Appendix: quick commands and rollback steps (Engineering on-call) — condensed and pasted into runbook card for one-click access.
